svg.title: Dürr–Høyer Minimum Finding, Part 1 — The Ladder, the Clock and the One-Climb Budget
svg.text: Dürr–Høyer Minimum Finding, Part 1 — The Ladder, the Clock and the One-Climb Budget

g.text: sin θ = √(M / N) , M = #{ z : Lz < Ly }
M = 0 ⇒ θ = 0 ⇒ Psucc(j) = 0 for every j ;
clock = Σ j + lg N · (1 + u) ;
E[ j | m ] < m / 2 , m₀ = 1 / sin 2θ
(m₀ is the critical m, see Part 2)
climb to m₀ < ½ Σs=1S λs−1
each failure: m → λ m, λ = 6/5
every round fails, and looks like before
the whole run on one clock
a round costs less than m / 2
the cap √N = 8 in place of m₀
one full climb, then stop the search
